regime_context: The detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative regime: Banks are the lone durable trend-leader (eligible, broad breadth, high durability_bar), while Coal is the only other eligible theme but its durability_bar (0.47) and hurst_tag ('mean-revert') argue against trend-following it. Critically, gate_helps is false — the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on A-shares history — and the detector's own track record shows dir_accuracy of only 0.337, so any directional lean here is highly fallible and must be framed as a falsifiable hypothesis, not a prediction.
emerging_watch: Watch Coal (515220.SS) as a potential challenger: if its relative strength vs Banks widens to put Coal's score within 0.02 of Banks' score while Coal's breadth expands above 0.5 and hurst_tag flips to 'trend', that would retire this watch and flag a CONFIRMED leadership handoff — otherwise the one-narrative Banks regime is intact.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme that passes the trend-gate (eligible==true) with high durability_bar (0.87), hurst_tag=='trend', and broad participation (breadth 0.944), which together describe an intact, cohesive trend rather than a narrow leader. This is the prevailing narrative and the detector's structure (one_narrative==true, absorption 0.35) says the regime is still concentrated there. The lean is direction-only and low-conviction because gate_helps is false on A-shares history and crowding_z (1.98, crowded==true) is a size-down caution, not a reason to add.
theses.dissent: This market mean-reverts: the backtest_verdict says the absolute-trend gate did_NOT_hold_here, and the detector's own dir_accuracy is 0.337. Banks are crowded (z≈2) and the most crowded leg of a one-narrative tape is where mean-reversion whipsaws hurt trend-followers hardest.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) underperforms CSI 300 by 8% relative over any rolling 20-day window before 2026-11-29

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme (eligible==true), but its durability_bar (0.47), hurst_tag=='mean-revert', and weak breadth (0.2) describe a thin, low-durability leader whose trend-following signal is much weaker than Banks. The rotation margin (0.071) is not a confirmed handoff. The avoid lean expresses that this theme is not a clean trend candidate on this tape, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Coal's low crowding and mean-revert texture mean it is not reflexively extended; if the one-narrative regime breaks, a mean-reverting theme with no crowding could rotate up faster than the crowded leader.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) outperforms CSI 300 by 10% relative over any rolling 20-day window before 2026-11-29

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
